summary: This note is a short biography of Dian Bachar, an American actor born October 26, 1970 in Denver, Colorado. It highlights his work in films associated with his friends Trey Parker and Matt Stone, including Cannibal! The Musical, Orgazmo, and BASEketball, where he played Kenny "Squeak" Scolari. It also notes occasional appearances on South Park and a minor role as an alien engineer in Galaxy Quest, most of which was cut.
one_line: American actor known for Trey Parker and Matt Stone films like BASEketball and Orgazmo, plus occasional South Park appearances.
key_facts: Dian Bachar was born October 26, 1970 in Denver, Colorado.
Dian Bachar is an American actor.
Dian Bachar is best known for his roles in films by or starring his friends Trey Parker and Matt Stone.
Dian Bachar played George Noon in Cannibal! The Musical.
Dian Bachar played Ben Chapleski in Orgazmo.
Dian Bachar's most famous role is Kenny "Squeak" Scolari in the 1998 film BASEketball.
Dian Bachar makes the occasional appearance on South Park.
Dian Bachar appeared as an alien engineer in Galaxy Quest.
Most of Dian Bachar's scenes in Galaxy Quest were cut.
Dian Bachar's cut Galaxy Quest scenes can be seen on the DVD's Special Features.
